text:
ops-bot: paging: High rate of GPU driver resets (Xid) observed on gpu-pool-us-east-3. Elevated ECC warnings, multiple container restarts. Trigger: 15-min rolling Xid count > 50. @oncall please investigate

maya: saw the alert, investigating now. which customer traffic is hitting that pool?

jun: looks like a subset of inference jobs from 'beta-dense' are sharded to that pool (dedicated nodes).

ali: I'm seeing kernel logs on node gpu-us-e3-12: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31` repeated, then `drm: rip` and container exits. attaching paste of dmesg lines:

ali: ```
Mar 15 03:12:21 gpu-us-e3-12 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, PID=0, GPU has fallen off the bus.
Mar 15 03:12:21 gpu-us-e3-12 kernel: nvme0n1: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 0
Mar 15 03:12:23 gpu-us-e3-12 kubelet[1234]: Container runtime reported exit code 134 for container redwood-runtime
```

maya: thanks ali. is this isolated to that node or many nodes?

jun: metric shows spikes across 3 nodes in the pool over the last 30m (12, 15, 22). pattern looks like ECC-related hardware errors followed by Xid 31 resets.

sre-kate: immediate mitigations we can do: cordon gpu-us-e3-12 and drain non-critical pods, move critical traffic to fallback pool, and mark nodes for hardware validation.

eng-runtime: can we failover model routing to alternative model variants? we have compatible quantized variant on fallback-pool-1 but needs routing update.

maya: initiating cordon/drain on gpu-us-e3-12 now. `kubectl cordon gpu-us-e3-12` -> done. starting safe drain for non-pset pods.

ops-bot: action log: maya cordoned gpu-us-e3-12 at 1919456962. drain started.

ali: draining shows some long-lived connections in model-serving namespace. I'll trigger graceful rollout for pods labeled `tier=stateless` first.

eng-runtime: starting runtime-side offload: update routing rules to prefer fallback-pool-1 for models in impacted customers. Rolling config change: `routes/model-serving/* -> fallback-pool-1` (canary 10%).

maya: canary applied (10%). monitoring error rates.

cs-luca: heads up — customer ZetaCorp reported 10-15% increase in 5xx for their recent batch jobs around 03:05 UTC. potentially impacted. raising support ticket and tagging customer success.

jun: confirming: 503 spike maps to requests routed to gpu-pool-us-east-3. fallback canary looks healthy so far. will ramp to 50% if stable.

sre-kate: escalate hardware ops: node flagged for ECC inspection. tagging infra oncall. add to incident board.

eng-runtime: can we reduce batch sizes / disable prefetch on the runtime for the impacted pool to reduce memory pressure until hardware ops completes?

ali: applied runtime override to reduce max_batch from 64 -> 16 on the pool via config manager. Deployed at 1919457225.

ops-bot: config change noted: runtime.max_batch set to 16 for pool gpu-pool-us-east-3 by ali.

maya: error rate on canary is stable, increasing traffic to 50%. monitoring traces.

inc-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0315-45 GPU driver resets causing node restarts. Severity: SEV2.

cs-luca: updating ticket: affected customers = ZetaCorp (batch), internal QA (smaller). estimated impact window 03:00-ongoing.

jun: after batch reduction, Xid frequency dropped by ~60% but not gone. suspect underlying memory/ECC faults still causing kernel to reset GPU.

eng-runtime: plan B if Xid persists: evacuate entire pool and failover to dedicated fallback clusters, enable degraded mode for non-critical features to reduce tail latency.

maya: coordinating with infra ops for physical inspection of the three nodes (gpu-us-e3-12, gpu-us-e3-15, gpu-us-e3-22). infra ops contact: @ali (cc infra oncall).

ali: infra ops response: scheduling hardware diagnostic now. asking to keep nodes cordoned and mark as unschedulable for new pods.

sre-kate: handoff note for next oncall (shift change in 40m): keep pool cordoned, continue routing to fallback-pool-1, maintain runtime batch reduction, monitor ECC counters. escalate to vendor (NVIDIA) if ECC correctable errors show upward trend.

maya: prepping summary for handoff:
- impact: intermittent 5xx for subset of customers; ZetaCorp degraded batch jobs 03:05-03:30 UTC.
- actions taken: cordoned/drained node gpu-us-e3-12; reduced runtime batch sizes; applied canary route to fallback-pool-1 and ramped to 50%; incident created INC-2026-0315-45.
- open items: infra diagnostics results, decide whether to reprovision nodes or request RMA.

eng-runtime: adding playbook reminder: run `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` on node to get ECC counts, capture `dmesg` and `journalctl -u kubelet` logs, and collect container crash stacks to attach to vendor ticket.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: collect vendor bundle at 1919460200 (next 6m).

ali: diagnostic outputs: node gpu-us-e3-12 shows correctable ECC errors count rising rapidly on GPU 0 -> recommending replacement module. attaching nv-smi snippet:

ali: ```
$ nvidia-smi -q -d ECC
GPU 0
    ECC Errors
        Volatile
            Single Bit ECC:  12345
            Double Bit ECC:      2
```

sre-kate: that double bit count is concerning. open vendor support and request urgent RMA for node gpu-us-e3-12 and schedule cordon for the other two if similar.

eng-runtime: continuing to route new traffic away and flagging degraded-mode for non-critical features. telemetry shows tail latency back to baseline for main customers after full failover at 1919458400.

cs-luca: notifying ZetaCorp account team: initial mitigation applied, engineers working on hardware replacement; will update ETA once infra confirms RMA.

maya: handoff to next oncall @sre-kate at 1919459700. key next steps in handoff message pinned.

sre-kate: taking over. I will monitor until RMA confirmed. If vendor RMA ETAs > 6h, we'll provision replacement nodes in another AZ as temporary capacity.

inc-bot: incident severity adjusted to SEV3 at 1919460000 — customer impact reduced after failover.

eng-runtime: keep a watch on fallback-pool resource saturation while this is ongoing — we may need to increase capacity there to avoid cascading latency.

maya: leaving final note before offline: logs and diagnostic bundles uploaded to incident ticket INC-2026-0315-45. thanks all. :heart:

sre-kate: thanks team. moving to monitoring-only unless new Xid spikes reported. will update when RMA confirmed or nodes reprovisioned.

ops-bot: incident status update: mitigated -> routing failover and batch reduction applied. nodes under hardware review.

eng-runtime: follow-up action items created: (1) postmortem writeup owner = jun, (2) vendor RMA tracking = ali, (3) routing automatic fallback test = eng-runtime.

cs-luca: will follow up with customers once we have RMA ETA.

inc-bot: incident closed for active customer impact at 1919460500 — watch for follow-ups and postmortem.
